title: Evening Bat Watching Kayak Tour
includes: kayaks, paddles, life-jackets, bottle of water, use of lockers
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
policies: Total tour time includes paddle instructions and gear distribution.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Kayaking to see the bats is a unique way to view this urban phenomenon, and seeing the Austin skyline from the water is a highlight of the trip! We are the original kayak tour operators to see the bats! We are a family-owned business that has been doing this for over 15 years. We have the most knowledgeable guides and dock staff! This is a great tour for families, date nights, tourist and locals alike!
